name: ReHold
rootCause: ReHold CTO Michael Semin disclosed on the X platform that on July 15, 2024, ReHold's CEO and co-founder, Renat Gafarov, withdrew over $700,000 from the company's smart contract without his approval. ReHold has since moved to a new domain.

descriptions.text: ReHold CTO Michael Semin disclosed on the X platform that on July 15, 2024, ReHold's CEO and co-founder, Renat Gafarov, withdrew over $700,000 from the company's smart contract without his approval. ReHold has since moved to a new domain.

A public incident catalogue lists ReHold's 2024-09-26 event on Ethereum as a $700,000 rug pull via admin drain, but the supporting record here does not include transaction-level evidence. Reported as an admin drain. The available evidence does not identify the privileged on-chain action or account that enabled the drain.
